description: This file defines a Spring service class 'CreateFinancialActivityAccountHandler' that handles the creation of financial activity accounts through the platform's command processing framework. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the creation operation to 'FinancialActivityAccountWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: CreateFinancialActivityAccountHandler
classes.description: Spring service class that handles commands for creating financial activity accounts, implementing command processing logic and delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a new financial activity account, by invoking the corresponding method on the write platform service.
